All required edits have been made to `src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts`:

1. **`createLeaveRequestSchema`**: Changed `startDate` and `endDate` from `z.date()` to `z.coerce.date()` (lines 60-61)
2. **`updateLeaveRequestSchema`**: Changed `startDate` and `endDate` from `z.date().optional()` to `z.coerce.date().optional()` (lines 74-75)
3. **`updateLeaveRequestSchema`**: Changed `approvedAt` from `z.date().nullable().optional()` to `z.coerce.date().nullable().optional()` (line 85)

**Verification:**
- `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit): ✅ passes with no type errors
- `npm test` (6 test suites, 70 tests): ✅ all pass

The `z.coerce.date()` change ensures ISO 8601 date strings from JSON request bodies are properly coerced to `Date` objects, satisfying GP-003 (input validation at API boundaries). The `.refine()` validation `startDate <= endDate` continues to work correctly since `z.coerce.date()` produces `Date` objects that support comparison operators.
